rows.name: variant
rows.description: contains the value of the Link variant.

rows.name: type
rows.description: contains the value of the Link type.

rows.name: label
rows.description: contains the value of the Link label.

rows.name: as
rows.description: Element to render. Use "button" to render a real <button type="button"> for click-action links. Defaults to "a". Ignored when Component is set.

rows.name: linkType
rows.description: contains the linkType, which is either a standard Link or a Button working like a link.

rows.name: disabled
rows.description: controls whether the Link is disabled

rows.name: leftIcon
rows.description: contains the left icon of the Link. While setting the icons, make sure that they are 16px * 16px in size.

rows.name: rightIcon
rows.description: contains the right icon of the Link. While setting the icons, make sure that they are 16px * 16px in size.

rows.name: alignment
rows.description: the alignment of the link inside of the container. can be 'right', 'left' or 'centered'

rows.name: Component
rows.description: Custom component to render as the link root (e.g., NextLink).

rows.name: ariaLabelLeftIcon
rows.description: Optional aria-label for the left icon, used to improve accessibility by providing a meaningful description for screen readers.

rows.name: ariaLabelRightIcon
rows.description: Optional aria-label for the left icon, used to improve accessibility by providing a meaningful description for screen readers.
